snippet.title: Shadow City Mysteries: A Clockwork Noir Trailer
snippet.description:
Shadow City Mysteries is a narrative adventure game in which players take on the role of a detective investigating a Mystery. Or is it a Conspiracy? Or is it a Supernatural Thriller? Experience the story multiple times to discover a story and world bigger than they suspected existed.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821240/Shadow_City_Mysteries_A_Clockwork_Noir/
